name: Fast Track

description.content: Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn [1] Token, up to [3].
While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains [5%] permanent progress.

quote: "The weak are sacrificed first. It's nature, it's business... it's the truth most refuse to face." -Yun-jin
